title: My child has limited interests. Can occupational therapy help widen their interests?
metaTitle: Expanding Your Child's Interests | Pinnacle Blooms Network
description: Learn how occupational therapy at Pinnacle Blooms Network can help diversify the interests of children with autism, promoting a more adaptable and enjoyable lifestyle.
html: Absolutely! At Pinnacle Blooms Network, we understand that children with autism might have restricted interests. To address this, our occupational therapists creatively incorporate these interests into therapy sessions, using them as positive reinforcement. While engaging in a familiar activity, new ones are gradually introduced to broaden their horizons.
